name: Smoke Flavourings
aliases: smoke flavouring, smoke flavoring, smoke flavour, smoke flavor, liquid smoke, smoke condensate, smoke flavouring preparation, smoke flavoring preparation
what_is: Flavouring preparations produced from smoke or smoke condensates and added to foods to provide or reinforce a smoky flavour. They are distinct from merely describing a food as traditionally smoked.
why_botia: BOTIA flags explicit smoke-flavouring declarations because EU authorisations for smoke-flavouring primary products were not renewed and transitional periods depend on food category. EFSA's 2023 assessments could not rule out genotoxicity concerns for the renewal products assessed. That regulatory/scientific context is not a claim that any product described as smoked contains an added smoke flavouring.
can_1: Detect explicit smoke flavouring, smoke flavoring, liquid smoke and closely related declared ingredient terms.
can_2: Explain the EU regulatory transition and distinguish added smoke flavourings from traditional smoking when the label gives that information.
cannot_1: Infer that a product contains added smoke flavouring merely because its name says smoked or smoky.
cannot_2: Determine which primary smoke-flavouring product or dose was used unless the label identifies it.

sources.label: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2067 — smoke flavouring primary products and transitional periods
